description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Dark/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, ATK/MAG/DEF/RES +30% for 8 seconds to party, Lv.3 En-Dark, En-Dark Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: En-Dark Damage +20%, Physical Casting Speed x1.1 & chases a Dark ability with 70% maxHP recoil and [Cap Break Level 1 & Dark Ability Damage +30%] for 3 turns to user (max 1 chase)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Dark, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Duskblade+: Higher multiplier & Cap Break Level 1 after 3 uses; Shadowblade+: 1.2s CT
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user

description.name: Shadowblade+
description.text: Five single attacks (? each), heals the user for 20% of the damage dealt

description.name: Duskblade+
description.text: Seven single attacks (?/? each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses, smart ether 1 to the user every second activation
